# Runtime Web

> Self-hosted console for writing, deploying and running apps on 21 Cloud Runtime (Apache-2.0). The console is a React
> single-page app (`web/`) served by a TypeScript backend (`server/`) that runs as the App `rtweb` on a runtime node.
> Users make orgs and projects, create apps, edit code in the browser, read logs, set triggers, custom domains and
> scoped tokens. An installer (`install.sh`) sets up the node, the console and Caddy with automatic TLS on one Linux host.

Docs site: https://21-ci.github.io/runtime-web/ . Source: https://github.com/21-ci/runtime-web .

## Install and operate

- [Install](https://21-ci.github.io/runtime-web/getting-started/install/): requirements, the installer and its options, upgrade, uninstall
- [Manual install](https://21-ci.github.io/runtime-web/getting-started/manual-install/): deploy onto an existing 21 Cloud Runtime node
- [First run](https://21-ci.github.io/runtime-web/getting-started/first-run/): setup token, instance admin account
- [Admin guide](https://21-ci.github.io/runtime-web/admin/): instance admin console, account recovery
- [Operations](https://21-ci.github.io/runtime-web/admin/operations/): node, custom domains and TLS, backups and keys, upgrades
- [Troubleshooting](https://21-ci.github.io/runtime-web/troubleshooting/): health checks, logs, common failures
- [Configuration](https://21-ci.github.io/runtime-web/reference/configuration/): every service env var, secret, installer variable and Caddy variable
- [Security model](https://21-ci.github.io/runtime-web/security-model/): trust boundaries, sessions, authorization, what is not protected

## Use the console

- [User guide](https://21-ci.github.io/runtime-web/user-guide/): orgs, projects, apps, editor, logs, triggers, tokens and keys, domains, members, two-factor auth and OAuth

## API

- [HTTP API reference](https://21-ci.github.io/runtime-web/reference/api/): every route of the console API with its auth rules and errors. Source of truth: `docs/reference/api.md` in the repository, checked by `server/test/contract.test.ts`

- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/21-ci/runtime-web/blob/main/SECURITY.md): reporting vulnerabilities, supported versions

## Terms

- App: a unit of user code deployed to 21 Cloud Runtime. Never called a "val" or a "service" in the console.
- Org, project, member, grant: the access model. Org roles are owner, admin and member; project roles are admin, developer and viewer.
- Token: a scoped credential. Key: the default org key.
